MgmtAppRecordingRequest.description:
The `recording` object of `POST /mgmt/v1/apps/{app_id}/settings`: any subset of an App's
recording settings; absent fields are kept. Refused for the home client (`409 conflict`
`home_client_cannot_govern`).

audio_max_days.description:
The most audio keep days a recording in the App's Spaces may have (the org's
`recording.audio_max_days` still caps it); `null` clears it.

cap_required.description: The App's sessions need the pass cap `voice:record` to start or stop recordings.

required.description: Record every call with two or more people in the App's governed Spaces.

server_read.description:
The App's server may read the recordings, transcripts and recording feed of its
governed Spaces over mgmt.

start_level.description:
The lowest level of the App's governed Spaces whose members may start and stop
recordings (`member`: everyone in the Space).

RecordingStartLevel.description:
The lowest level of an App's governed Space whose members may start and stop
recordings. `member` means everyone in the Space. Stored as its wire string.

oneOf.description: Nobody through the App's levels (the default; roles and overwrites still apply).

SpaceLevel.description:
A person's level in an App-governed Space (K2's sync sets it), and an App's
`max_level`. `moderator` and `admin` are the Space's managed roles; `member` is
`@everyone`.

oneOf.description: The managed Admin role (the Moderator bits plus MENTION_EVERYONE).

description: Body of `POST /mgmt/v1/apps/{app_id}/settings`: any subset of the fields.

display_name.description:
The App's name as clients label its Spaces (`Space.app_display_name`), 1–100
characters; `null` clears it.

hidden_from_home.description: Leave the App's Spaces out of the home client.

max_level.description:
The highest level K2's sync may give in the App's governed Spaces (default
`moderator`). Refused for the home client (`409 home_client_cannot_govern`).

origin.description:
The App's public origin, `wss://<host>[:port]`: the signalling URL of the voice and
call join answers of the App's sessions; `null` clears it.

origins.description:
Flag `app_origins`: the App's further web origins, each `wss://<host>[:port]`
as `origin`, at most 32: a voice or call join of the App's sessions may name `origin` or
one of these as its own `origin` (the host the browser reached the App on). Duplicates
are dropped and the list is kept sorted; `null` or `[]` clears it.

recording.description:
Flag `app_recording`: any subset of the App's recording settings. Refused for the
home client (`409 home_client_cannot_govern`, field `recording`).

uploads.description:
Whether the App's people may upload files in its governed Spaces (default
`true`).

title: MgmtAppSettingsRequest
